# Wand of the War Mage (`magic-items:wand-of-the-war-mage`)
**Category:** [Wands](../equipment-categories/wands.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon (+1), Rare (+2), or Very Rare (+3) | **Attunement:** Yes | **Limited to:** Spellcaster
**Variants:** [Wand of the War Mage +1](../magic-items/wand-of-the-war-mage-1.md), [Wand of the War Mage +2](../magic-items/wand-of-the-war-mage-2.md), [Wand of the War Mage +3](../magic-items/wand-of-the-war-mage-3.md)

Wand

While holding this wand, you gain a bonus to spell attack rolls determined by the wand's rarity. In addition, you ignore Half Cover when making a spell attack roll.
